name: Pelias
tagline: Open-source geocoding API for address search, reverse geocoding, and place autocomplete.
description: Pelias is an open-source geocoding engine exposed via Geocode Earth's hosted API (api.geocode.earth). It turns free-text addresses and place names into structured geographic coordinates, supports reverse geocoding, and offers autocomplete-style search for maps and location apps.

auth.details: API key via the api_key query parameter; self-serve signup through Geocode Earth.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No permanent free tier; two-week free trial with no credit card required.
pricing.paid_plans: Lite $100/mo (150k req, ≤10 rps); Basic $200/mo (400k, ≤10 rps); Advanced $500/mo (2M, ≤20 rps); Custom for higher volume.

rate_limits: Plan-dependent: hard per-second limits (Lite/Basic up to 10 rps, Advanced up to 20 rps); trial plans also have hard per-day limits; all plans have soft monthly request allowances.

example.response_snippet: {"geocoding":{"version":"0.2","attribution":"https://geocode.earth/guidelines","query":{"text":"30 West 26th Street, New York, NY","size":10}},"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[{"type":"Feature","geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-73.9897,40.7441]},"properties":{"id":"openaddresses:address:us/ny/city_of_new_york:...","gid":"openaddresses:address:us/ny/city_of_new_york:...","layer":"address","source":"openaddresses","name":"30 West 26th Street","housenumber":"30","street":"West 26th Street","postalcode":"10010","confidence":0.9,"label":"30 West 26th Street, New York, NY, USA"}}]}

use_cases: geocode a street address to lat/lon
reverse geocode coordinates to an address
autocomplete place names as a user types
find nearby places from a point
